attributes.summary:
SHEA Spring 2027 runs March 30 to April 2, 2027, in Washington, D.C., with the Omni Shoreham Hotel as the conference hotel. Topics include healthcare epidemiology, infection prevention and antibiotic stewardship.

SHEA is jointly accredited and offers up to 58 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and 58 ANCC contact hours, including a pre-meeting workshop. Pharmacists can earn up to 20 live CPE hours from the stewardship course and selected sessions.

The group hotel rate is $289 a night until February 26, 2027. Registration fees were not on the pages we checked.
